statement: Fourteen topological relative-position types of three circles are listed and their contact-circle counts and contact types tabulated.

notes: The fourteen incidence types are not asserted to be fourteen connected real discriminant-complement chambers. TableI is inspected alongside its explanatory prose; historical special self-contact conventions must be retained.
